about_the_game:
JAGAR – Just a Game About a Rectangle is a minimalist 2D game that challenges your reflexes and precision. Take control of a simple rectangle through levels full of obstacles and platforming challenges that test your skill and quick thinking. Each stage requires calculated movements, precise jumps, and fast decisions — perfect for those who enjoy hardcore challenges and fast-paced gameplay.

Key Features:

  • Precision Platforming: levels designed to challenge reflexes and motor skills.

  • 25 Current Levels (with plans for more in the future): a campaign with increasing difficulty.

  • Minimalist and Abstract Style: straightforward gameplay with a clean, simplified visual aesthetic.

  • Arcade and Retro: quick sessions reminiscent of classic arcade games, but with a modern twist.

  • Progressive Challenge: linear stages that grow in difficulty, demanding perfect timing and reasoning.

  • Singleplayer: ideal for players who like to beat their own records and compete against themselves.

Whether you’re a fan of skill-based games or just looking for a minimalist and addictive experience, JAGAR delivers short, precise, and fun challenges that will test your patience and reflexes at every level.
